revision: PT6 fifth pass: measured attributed rejection, nonzero explicit prefixes and supplied targets
claim: Untrained text/prefix receiving mechanics only, not semantic competence or 31B fit authorization.

interface_controls.decode_mask_rule: Each independent singleton and mixed batch masks an appended token before a visible token. Preserve physical positions and exact retained masks, compare every cached step to full recompute, require masked-token invariance and a matched effect when those same tokens are visible.
interface_controls.time_rule: Unscaled seconds, no clipping: selected older evidence must match the production receiver oracle and differ from the same rows with within-range recent times. Certification covers these registered offsets, not arbitrary finite floats.
interface_controls.explicit_prefix_rule: Supply nonzero production-connector prefixes for original and changed memory; both must match native explicit-prefix logits and changing only the supplied prefix must change the answer slice.
interface_controls.supplied_label_rule: Supervise the registered answer positions with (input token + 1) modulo vocabulary, retaining -100 elsewhere; returned loss and every intended gradient must match independent shifted cross entropy.
interface_controls.mask_rule: Nonempty memory: change only masked entries without removing or moving physical positions; require visible answer-logit invariance and matched visible-entry effect. Both mixed-mask samples and their independent singletons must pass.
interface_controls.modality_rule: Hold content, roles, times, addressing and masks fixed; reverse only categorical modality IDs and require an effect independently of the 19/20 competence allowance.

content_recipe.algorithm: torch.randn with a private CPU Generator seeded by each case seed, float32; donor = -rows + 2
content_recipe.address_rule: Host exact index_map selector, represented by digest-bound row mask before production select; never supplied as a fake token or instruction.
content_recipe.row_order_rule: Aligned row/origin permutations are invariant for set cross-attention; shuffling contents WITHOUT their row bindings must change output.
content_recipe.modality_scope: Categorical type signals only; no image/audio/video processor or necessary-pixel competence.

measurement.batch_variant: Two different samples, original and reversed order; compare each restored answer slice to its singleton.
measurement.noise_floor: Maximum measured same-input repeat and singleton/batch/reordered-batch difference over both arms of every case, paired control and mandatory interface gate; compare all original samples.
measurement.noise_rule: Every measured noise floor <= noise_max_abs; nonfinite/empty outputs always fail.
measurement.parameters: Random initialization only. No optimizer, fit, parameter update, pretrained loader, network or GPU.
measurement.cache_rule: Separate unmasked and registered text-masked prefill gates plus appended-token mask trials: fresh prefills, cached steps vs full recompute, singleton and mixed-mask batch; extend the supplied mask for each decoded token, retain physical positions, reject consumed/foreign caches, fresh donor must differ from original.
measurement.gradient_rule: Separate nonempty-memory first-token and registered answer-target-slice backward gates. Returned finite differentiable scalar loss and its gradients must match independently computed shifted cross entropy; every connector parameter and memory input has finite nonzero gradients, stem remains frozen/eval without gradients, and parameters remain unchanged. No optimizer steps.
measurement.selection_rule: Every successful competence/selection control record must exactly reconstruct deterministic fixture digests, legal selected indices, refusals and interventions. Unkeyed custody and semantic consistency only, not arbitrary-writer authentication.

pass_rule.adversaries: Every registered must-fail receiver runs the SAME full 20-case/six-live-control/critical-gate evaluator. Only an explicit correctly attributed measured rejection counts. Any crash, exception, timeout, missing result or invalid measurement is CHECK_FAILED, never REJECTED. Zero measured noise is legal. Constant and digest-echo rejection also supply P04/P05.

paired_controls.oracle: Independent source-free donor reload with same frozen production receiver; numerical donor-follow, not a semantic answer oracle.
